title: Oscar and the Inheritance
author: E. M. Sterling
blurb: Wren Sandoval, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has spent twenty years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
